channel.title: Coloring for Kidz
channel.description: Coloring and puzzle books for kids and families by Jaylen Johnson

item.g:title: Animal Adventures Coloring Book for Kids Ages 4-8 by Jaylen Johnson
item.g:description: Meet 12 friendly animals and color them in! Lions, elephants, giraffes, pandas, penguins, sea turtles, owls, frogs, whales, butterflies, octopuses and hedgehogs are all waiting inside. Detailed pictures packed with patterns to color. A fun animal fact on every page. Single-sided pages, blank on the back. Great for crayons, pencils and markers. Paperback, 8.5 x 11 inches, 30 pages.

item.g:title: Bible Coloring Book for Kids: 40 New Testament Stories by Jaylen Johnson
item.g:description: From the night baby Jesus was born to the day of Pentecost, kids can color their way through 40 favorite New Testament stories. Each picture comes with a short Bible verse to read, remember and talk about together. 40 original, detailed pictures with no clip art. Simple and detailed pages for every skill level. A New King James Version verse on every page. A "This Book Belongs To" page up front. Big 8.5 × 11 inch pages. Great for Sunday school, homeschool and gifts. Paperback, 8.5 x 11 inches, 44 pages.

item.g:title: Bible Coloring Book for Adults: 40 Intricate New Testament Designs by Jaylen Johnson
item.g:description: Slow down and spend quiet time with the stories of Jesus. This book holds 40 original, detailed designs inspired by the New Testament, from the Star of Bethlehem to the Holy City, each with a Bible verse to read and think about while you color. 40 original, hand-crafted designs. A New King James Version verse on every page. Mandalas, stained glass and flowing patterns. Large 8.5 × 11 inch pages. A thoughtful gift for church friends and family. Paperback, 8.5 x 11 inches, 44 pages.

item.g:title: Faith & Fun: A Bible Puzzle Book with 100 Puzzles by Jaylen Johnson
item.g:description: Take the whole family on a journey through the Bible, one puzzle at a time. From creation to the empty tomb, every page brings a favorite Bible story to life. Puzzles start easy and get more challenging, so beginners and Bible experts alike will have plenty to enjoy. 32 word searches, 14 mazes and 10 letter sudoku pages. Crosswords, scrambles, matching games and trivia. Cryptograms, riddles, finish-the-verse and word ladders. Easy, medium and hard levels. Full answer key. Scripture from the King James Version. Paperback, 8.5 x 11 inches, 128 pages.
